name: Tucker Foundation Environmental Conservation Grants
summary: A private foundation in Tennessee that gives to non-profits conserving the natural environment, mainly for land acquisition or conservation easements, in a few named areas of Tennessee and Wyoming. Reviewed twice a year through an online system.

geography.label: Chattanooga, Cleveland (Tennessee) and Sheridan and Johnson counties (Wyoming)

calls.label: Twice-yearly review (March 31 and September 30)

status.quote: Grants are reviewed two times each year. The first annual deadline is March 31st, and the second is September 30th.

recurring.quote: Grants are reviewed two times each year. The first annual deadline is March 31st, and the second is September 30th.

calls.recurring: Deadlines of March 31 and September 30 each year, as the funder states them without a year.

applicant_types.quote: to provide financial support to non-profit organizations to produce in young people the character and skills required to live a productive and happy life, along with organizations that conserve essential elements of our natural environment forever.

geography.quote: Geographic Concentration Chattanooga/Hamilton County MSA, Tennessee Cleveland/Bradley County MSA, Tennessee Sheridan County and Johnson County, Wyoming

access.quote: The Tucker Foundation accepts applications only through its online application system.
